one_line: Weak-mass internal excitation of a completely screened static unit charge in the one-flavour massive Schwinger model.

source_model.field_theory: One-flavour massive QED in 1+1 dimensions with a fixed external unit charge, mapped to the standard Coleman-normal-ordered scalar Hamiltonian.
source_model.calculation: Task-authored background-field boundary-value solve, linear fluctuation spectrum, large-volume localization check, and weak-coupling coefficient extraction.

primary_references.citation: S. Coleman, More About the Massive Schwinger Model, Annals of Physics 101, 239-267 (1976).
primary_references.use: Bosonized massive Schwinger-model normalization and semiclassical scalar formulation.
